title: Kammlerstab Nazi tech transfer to Wright Field
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Kammlerstab Nazi tech transfer to Wright Field, about 1940s at Czechoslovakia / Wright Field, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: there's actually a secret kind of weapons facility in Czechoslovakia in Modern Day Poland run by SS officer Hans commer

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that during the 1940s there was a secret weapons facility in Czechoslovakia, which he places in modern-day Poland, run by Hans Kammler, an officer in the SS, the Nazi party's elite force. In Michels's telling, technology from that work, tied to figures such as Richard Miethe, Viktor Schauberger and Henri Coanda, ended up at Wright Field, a US military air base in Ohio. If true, it would mean advanced Nazi designs fed straight into American secret aircraft research.
